10.17日更新：
适配IOS源阅，IOS设备不支持段评
修复段评楼中楼部分回复无数据的情况
推荐书籍新增等级标签显示(没什么用,纯好看)

注：阅读请使用最新测试版
1.所有源站每20秒最多15章，把预下载调到0-3之间使用[打赏VIP白名单无请求限制]
2.自定义源站示例：番茄小说,七猫小说  多个源站用英文,号分隔
源站名参考 登录URL //书源配置列表 v参数

3.源站带有❇️图标表示只能指定或@搜索

4.搜索模式：
书名@来源 多个来源用英文,号分隔
示例： 
系统@番茄小说，多个源站使用英文,号分隔
书名@类型 返回对应类型所有源站数据，可直接使用@方式搜索或者点击登陆切换模式
示例： 
系统@小说  听书  漫画  短剧等
默认书名排序
指定作者优先：
作者名@作者   作者名@作者,源站

<js>
let config = (() => {
    try {
        let cfg = JSON.parse(source.getVariable())[0] || {};
        if (!cfg.host || !cfg.gender) {
            cfg = {gender: "boy", host: getServerHost()};
            source.setVariable(JSON.stringify([cfg]));
            java.toast("配置初始化完成");
        }
        return cfg;
    } catch(e) {
        let cfg = {gender: "boy", host: getServerHost()};
        source.setVariable(JSON.stringify([cfg]));
        return cfg;
    }
})();
    
let rawVariable = source.getVariable();
let 个人中心 = 1;
let obj = (title, url, type) => ({
  title: title,
  url: url,
  style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: type }
});

let sort = [];
let push = (title, url, type) => sort.push(obj(title, url, type));

let currentType = "";
let currentSource = "";
try {
  let vArray = JSON.parse(rawVariable);
  if (vArray.length > 0) {
    let v = vArray[0];
    currentType = v.gender || "";
    currentSource = v.source || "";
    
    if (currentSource == "推荐") {
      currentType = "recommend";
      v.gender = "recommend";
      source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(vArray));
    } else if (currentType == "recommend") {
      currentType = "boy";
      v.gender = "boy";
      source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(vArray));
    }
  }
} catch(e) {
  currentType = "";
  currentSource = "";
}

const getGenderDisplayName = (gender) => {
  if (gender == "boy") return "男频";
  if (gender == "girl") return "女频";
  if (gender == "recommend") return "推荐";
  return "";
};

const genderDisplay = getGenderDisplayName(currentType);

push(`当前为【${currentSource || "番茄小说"}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}`, "", 1);

const excludedSources = ["小说", "听书", "漫画", "视频", "短剧", "音频","番茄小说"];

if (currentSource && currentSource !== "推荐" && !excludedSources.includes(currentSource)) {
  try {
    let apiUrl = `${getServerHost()}/type_api?source=${currentSource}`;
    if (currentType) {
      apiUrl += `&gender=${currentType}`;
    }
    
    let response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(apiUrl));
    
    if (response.data && response.data.found) {
      response.data.found.forEach(item => {
        let finalUrl = "";
        if (item.url) {
          finalUrl = `${getServerHost()}/type_api?source=${currentSource}&page={{page}}&url=${item.url}`;
          if (currentType) {
            finalUrl += `&gender=${currentType}`;
          }
        }
        sort.push({
          title: item.title,
          url: finalUrl,
          style: item.style || { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29 }
        });
      });
    } else {
      push(`【${currentSource}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}暂无数据`, "", 1);
    }
  } catch(e) {
    push(`【${currentSource}】${genderDisplay ? `【${genderDisplay}】` : ''}暂无数据`, "", 1);
  }
  JSON.stringify(sort);
} else if (currentType == "recommend" && currentSource == "推荐") {
  
  let maleCategories = [];
  try {
    let maleResponse = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/api?action=subcategories&top_category_id=1"));
      maleCategories = maleResponse.data;
  } catch(e) {
    push('男频分类加载失败，请检查网络', "", 1);
  }
  
  let femaleCategories = [];
  try {
    let femaleResponse = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/api?action=subcategories&top_category_id=2"));
femaleCategories = femaleResponse.data;
  } catch(e) {
    push('女频分类加载失败，请检查网络', "", 1);
  }
  
  if (maleCategories && maleCategories.length > 0) {
    push('♂️ 男频推荐 ♂️', "", 1);
    maleCategories.forEach(cat => {
      push(cat.name, `${getServerHost()}/api?action=books&sub_category_id=${cat.id}&limit=20&page={{page}}`, 0.29);
    });
  } else if (!maleCategories || maleCategories.length == 0) {
    push('男频分类暂无数据', "", 1);
  }
  
  if (femaleCategories && femaleCategories.length > 0) {
    push('♀️ 女频推荐 ♀️', "", 1);
    femaleCategories.forEach(cat => {
      push(cat.name, `${getServerHost()}/api?action=books&sub_category_id=${cat.id}&limit=20&page={{page}}`, 0.29);
    });
  } else if (!femaleCategories || femaleCategories.length === 0) {
    push('女频分类暂无数据', "", 1);
  }
  
  JSON.stringify(sort);
} else {
  let recommendUrl = getServerHost() + "/read_recommend?session=" + getSessionId();
  push('个性推荐', recommendUrl, 0.29);
  push('巅峰榜单', 'https://fanqienovel.com/api/author/misc/top_book_list/v1/?limit=100&offset={{(page-1)*100}}', 0.29);
  push('出版榜单', 'https://fanqienovel.com/api/node/publication/list?page_index={{(page-1)*100}}&page_count=100', 0.29);
  push('爆更榜单', 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=15&type=1', 0.29);
  push('黑马榜单', 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=13&type=1', 0.29);
  push('热搜榜单', 'https://api-lf.fanqiesdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/rank/rank_list/v2/?aid=13&limit=50&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&side_type=12&type=1', 0.29);	

  let fqCategoryArr = [];
  let showCategories = currentType == "girl" ? [0] : (currentType == "boy" ? [1] : [0, 1]);

  showCategories.forEach(i => {
    try {
      let response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`${getServerHost()}/type?new_category_tab=${i}`));
      let $ = response.data.category_tab_data;
      
      let tabName = $.tab_name || (i == 0 ? "女频" : "男频");
      fqCategoryArr.push(obj(`❤️${tabName}分类❤️`, null, 1));
      
      $.cell_data.forEach(c => {
        fqCategoryArr.push(obj(c.cell_name, null, 1));
        
        if (c.atom_data && Array.isArray(c.atom_data)) {
          c.atom_data.slice(1).forEach(a => {
            let d = a.category_data;
            if (d && d.name) {
              let gender = i;
              let genre = 0;
              let cid = d.category_id;
              
              fqCategoryArr.push({
                title: d.name,
                url: `${getServerHost()}/type?category_id=${cid}&genre=${genre}&gender=${gender}&limit=20&offset={{(page-1)*100}}`,
                style: {
                  layout_flexGrow: 1,
                  layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29
                }
              });
            }
          });
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      fqCategoryArr.push(obj("分类加载失败，请重试", null, 1));
    }
  });

  fqCategoryArr.forEach(item => {
  if (item.style && item.style.layout_flexBasisPercent) {
    push(item.title, item.url, item.style.layout_flexBasisPercent);
  } else {
    sort.push({
      title: item.title,
      url: item.url,
      style: {
        layout_flexGrow: 1,
        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.29
      }
    });
  }
});

category = () => {

    return JSON.parse(java.ajax(category_url)).data;
}

if(currentType == "girl") {

    categoryList.forEach(($,index)=>{

        push(title, url, 0.29);	
    });
} else {
    let [tit1, gender, categoryList] = categoryData[0];
    push('其它分类', null, 1);
    categoryList.forEach(($,index)=>{
        index++;
        title = $.category_name;
        cid = $.category_id;
        url=  `https://novel.snssdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/new_category/book_list/v1/?aid=1967&app_name=news_article&app_version=9.7.3&channel=tengxun_tt&creation_status=9&device_platform=android&enter_from=novel_category&novel_host&novel_version&version_code=973&version_name=9.7.3&word_count=9&os=android&device_type=ProjectTitan&os_api=29&os_version=10&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&limit=100&category_id=${cid}&${gender}`;
        push(title, url, 0.29);

}

let [tit1, gender, categoryList] = categoryData[2];
push('❤️'+tit1+'❤️', null, 1);
categoryList.forEach(($,index)=>{
    index++;
    title = $.category_name;
    cid = $.category_id;
    url=  `https://novel.snssdk.com/api/novel/channel/homepage/new_category/book_list/v1/?aid=1967&app_name=news_article&app_version=9.7.3&channel=tengxun_tt&creation_status=9&device_platform=android&enter_from=novel_category&novel_host&novel_version&version_code=973&version_name=9.7.3&word_count=9&os=android&device_type=ProjectTitan&os_api=29&os_version=10&offset={{(page-1)*100}}&limit=100&category_id=${cid}&${gender}`;
    push(title, url, 0.29);	
});

  let hasValidSession = false;

try {

ruleContent.content:
<js>
eval(String(source.loginUrl));

let deviceParam = chapter.url.match(/device=([^&]*)/)?.[1] || 'android';
const isAndroid = deviceParam == 'android';

let book_id = chapter.url.match(/book_id=(\d{19})/)?.[1];
let item_id = chapter.url.match(/item_id=(\d+)/)?.[1];
let qm_id = null;

if (/七猫短剧/.test(chapter.url)) {
    try {
        const urlParam = chapter.url.match(/url=([^&]+)/)?.[1];
        if (urlParam) {
            const decodedUrl = java.base64Decode(urlParam);
            qm_id = decodedUrl.match(/qm_id=(\d+)/)?.[1]
        }
    } catch (e) {}
}

let contentUrl = getServerHost() + baseUrl.split(',')[0].replace(/^https?:\/\/[^\/]+/, '') + `&key=${getSecretKey()}&version=9`;
let response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(contentUrl));
let result = response.data.content;

if ((/番茄短剧/.test(chapter.url) && book_id) || (/七猫短剧/.test(chapter.url) && qm_id)) {
    try {
        const paramName = /番茄短剧/.test(chapter.url) ? 'book_id' : 'qm_id';
        const paramValue = /番茄短剧/.test(chapter.url) ? book_id : qm_id;
        const videoUrl = getServerHost() + `/player?${paramName}=${paramValue}&key=${getSecretKey()}`;
        if (book.durChapterIndex == chapter.index) {
            java.startBrowser(videoUrl, chapter.title || '视频播放');
            java.toast('视频加载中...')
        }
        result = `▶️刷新正文进入播放界面`
    } catch (e) {}
}

if (response.data.tab == "video" && book.durChapterIndex == chapter.index && !/番茄短剧|七猫短剧/.test(chapter.url)) {
    let normalVideoUrl = java.base64Decode(result.trim());
    java.startBrowser(normalVideoUrl, chapter.title || '视频播放');
    java.toast('视频加载中...');
    result = `▶️刷新正文进入播放界面`
}

if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(result.trim())) {
    if (isAndroid) {
        with(new JavaImporter(Packages.java.util.zip, Packages.java.io, Packages.android.util)) {
            let bytes = Base64.decode(result, Base64.DEFAULT);
            try {
                let reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(new InflaterInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)), "UTF-8"));
                let content = "";
                while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) content += line + "\n";
                reader.close();
                result = content.trim()
            } catch (e) {
                try {
                    let rawReader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), "UTF-8"));
                    let rawContent = "";
                    while ((line = rawReader.readLine()) != null) rawContent += line + "\n";
                    rawReader.close();
                    result = rawContent.trim()
                } catch (e2) {}
            }
        }
    } else {
        try {
            result = java.base64Decode(result.trim());
        } catch (e) {}
    }
}

if (chapter.url.includes('tone_id=')) {
    let toneId = chapter.url.match(/tone_id=([^&]*)/)?.[1] || '';
    if (toneId && item_id) {
        try {
            let apiData = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() + `/audio?tone_id=${toneId}&item_ids=${item_id}`));
            if (apiData.data?.[0]?.main_url) result = apiData.data[0].main_url
        } catch (e) {}
    }
}

if (isAndroid && java.get("fqparas") == "on" && java.get("fqdown") != "on" && book_id && !chapter.url.includes('tone_id=')) {
    result = result.replace(/\n+/g, "\n");
    result = getComments(result, book_id, item_id)
}

if (isAndroid) {
    try {
        let config = JSON.parse(source.getVariable());
        let now = Date.now();
        let fourHours = 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        if (!config[0].lastUpdateCheck || (now - config[0].lastUpdateCheck) > fourHours) {
            config[0].lastUpdateCheck = now;
            source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(config));
            let versionData = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/version?vid=sy"));
            if (versionData.version) {
                if (versionData.force && versionData.force.toString().toLowerCase() == "true" && versionData.version > localVersion) {
                    java.startBrowser(version());
                    result = "请更新书源！下载页面已打开。"
                }
                let msg = versionData.version > localVersion ? `\n✨发现新版本V${versionData.version}(当前V${localVersion})` + (versionData.msg ? `\n${versionData.msg}` : '') : versionData.version < localVersion ? `\n⚠️版本异常\n本地V${localVersion}>云端V${versionData.version}\n请检查书源配置` : '';
                if (msg) java.toast(msg)
            } else if (versionData.msg) {
                java.toast(versionData.msg)
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        java.toast("⚠️ 版本检查失败: " + e.message)
    }
}

let tab = response.data.tab || "";
let fq = response.data.source || "";
let notice = response.data.notice || "";
if (tab == "novel" && notice && notice.trim() !== "") {
    result += "\n" + notice
}

if (fq == "番茄小说" && tab == "novel" && book_id) {
    if (java.get("fqdown") == "on" && book.durChapterIndex == chapter.index) {
        java.startBrowser(getServerHost() + `/down?key=${getSecretKey()}&book_id=` + book_id, "番茄");
        java.toast("\n当前下载模式已开启，在线阅读请先关闭下载模式！！！");
        result = "🔄 刷新跳转到下载页面，在线阅读请关闭下载模式后刷新正文..."
    }
}

result = result.replace(chapter.title, '');
</js>

<js>
function getBookIdFull(url) {
    const {java} = this;
    let $ = JSON.parse(url).data;
    let arr = [];
    if ($.book_shelf_info && $.book_shelf_info.length > 0) {
        arr = $.book_shelf_info.map(item => item.book_id);
    } else if ($.data_list && $.data_list.length > 0) {
        arr = $.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str);
    } else {
        java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！");
    }
    return arr;
}

let session = getSessionId()

getShelf = () => {
    let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/book_shelf?session=" + session)
    
    bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
    
    let id_list = splitArray(bid, 200)
    let urls = []
    id_list.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
    let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/book_shelf?session=" + session))
    
    let group_bookids = {
        "未分组": []
    }
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
        if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
        group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
    })
    
    if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
    
    let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 200)
    let urls = []

    book_ids.forEach(i => { 	urls.push("https://api5-normal-sinfonlineb.fqnovel.com/reading/bookapi/multi-detail/v/?aid=1967&iid=1&version_code=999&book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
    let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
        "bookmall/tab",
        "version_name=5.8.9.32",
        null,
        "sessionid=" + session
    )
    let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
    let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
    if (!tab) tab = []
    let bookList = []
    for (let i of tab) {
        bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    return { book_info: bookList }
}

function normalizeResponse(data) {
    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.result) return data.data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {
        return data.data.cell_view.book_data;
    }
    if (data.data && data.data.records) return data.data.records;
    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    return [];
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) {
    result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
} else if(/read_history/.test(baseUrl)) {
    let pageMatch = baseUrl.match(/page=(\d+)/);
    let page = pageMatch ? pageMatch[1] : '1';
    
    let history_response = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/read_history?session=" + session + "&page=" + page)
    let history_data = JSON.parse(history_response)
    
    if (history_data.code == 0 && history_data.data && history_data.data.data_list) {
        let book_ids = history_data.data.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str)
        
        let id_list = splitArray(book_ids, 200)
        let urls = []
        id_list.forEach(i => {
            urls.push("https://api5-normal-sinfonlineb.fqnovel.com/reading/bookapi/multi-detail/v/?aid=1967&iid=1&version_code=999&book_id=" + i.join(","))
        })
        
        let resp = {book_info: []}
        urls.forEach(url => {
            let detailResponse = java.ajax(url)
            let detailData = JSON.parse(detailResponse)
            if (detailData.data) {
                resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(detailData.data)
            }
        })
        
        result = resp
    } else {
        result = {book_info: []}
    }
} else {
    let w = baseUrl.split("/")
    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
    } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
        result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
    } else {
        result = JSON.parse(result)
        if (result.data && result.data.data) {
            result = {book_info: result.data.data}
        }
    }
}

let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);

JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData})

    }

        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

}

    const urlToMatch = x.url || catalog.url;
    const bookId = urlToMatch.match(/book_id=(\d{19})\b/)?.[1] || null;
    const itemId = urlToMatch.match(/item_id=(\d+)/)?.[1] || null;
    
    let contentUrl = getServerHost() + `/chapter?cid=${x.cid}&source=${catalog.source}&device=${device}`;
    
    if (!isFanqieApp) {
        contentUrl += `&url=${catalog.url}`;
    } else {
        contentUrl += `&book_id=${bookId}&item_id=${itemId}`;
        
        if (['番茄听书', '番茄畅听'].includes(catalog.source)) {
            const toneId = Number((source.getLoginInfoMap())['听书AI音色编号']) || 1;

        x.url = `${contentUrl},${commentPart}`;
    } else {
        x.url = contentUrl;
    }
    
    return x;
});
